candidates.entry: accepted M15 Bid open after failure
candidates.exit: accepted M15 Bid open 8 bars later

candidates.entry: first raw tick timestamp >= failure_bar_end; LONG at Ask, SHORT at Bid
candidates.exit: first raw tick timestamp >= entry_boundary_plus_120_minutes; LONG at Bid, SHORT at Ask

candidates.confirmation: the first completed raw-tick-derived M1 bar after failure_bar_end must close on the failure side of the shock midpoint and have a body in the entry direction
candidates.entry: first raw tick after that M1 bar completes; LONG at Ask, SHORT at Bid
candidates.exit: first raw tick timestamp >= original failure_bar_end_plus_120_minutes; LONG at Bid, SHORT at Ask
first raw tick timestamp >= failure_bar_end_plus_60_minutes; LONG at Bid, SHORT at Ask

selection.held_out_blinding: held-out fold is never used for candidate selection or tie-breaking
ranking: highest median training-fold net under observed spread plus 0.5 pip extra spread and 0.5 pip slippage per execution
training_gate: at least 2 of 3 training folds net > 0
